title: Dislocation Network Tomography via Focused Ion Beam-Electron Channeling Contrast Imaging
content: Characterization of structural defect networks in three-dimensions (3D) can provide vital information on fundamental defect dynamics, dislocation-dislocation interactions, spatial density variations, etc. The majority of this limited characterization is currently done by methods that rely on estimates via calculations of dislocation density such as synchrotron x-ray diffraction methods or high-resolution electron backscattered diffraction (EBSD) in the scanning electron microscope (SEM). Performing electron channeling contrast imaging (ECCI) in the focused ion beam (FIB) - SEM, however, presents an opportunity to characterize individual structural defects such as dislocations directly.
